notes.title: One Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421736/9b8604519d330e05c602ea95635dc751891f811e.png[/img]

On this day last year (6/22/2016) Potato Thriller released on Steam. I cannot believe that the game has already been out for a full year. Thank you everyone from the bottom of my heart for all the support you have given the game and myself as a game developer! 

Full blog post here: 
[url=http://snowconesolidwho.blogspot.com/2017/06/potato-thriller-1-year-anniversary.html] Happy Birthday Potato Man![/url]

I look forward to sharing new games and crazy adventures with all of you.
Looking to the future! :)

-Samer Khatib (Snowconesolid)

notes.title: Potato Updates + Game Sale + Developer News
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/486650/ss_fb160a59df738058b8543bc8a68117512f1c12f0.600x338.jpg?t=1481233605[/img]

[b]Game Updates: [/b]
     A couple weeks back Potato Thriller has silently been getting updated and re-uploaded to Steam. Each build more superior then the last. Many owners and original first time buyers of the game may have been unaware of these updates.

To inform current owners and potential new buyers interested in the game here is a list of changes.  
[list]
    [*]Lots of new hidden secrets and content. 
    [*]Cleaner UI's and menu
    [*]Ugly in game UI replaced with completely new modern game prompts. (no more hud)
    [*]Broken auto-save features fixed in certain levels.
    [*]Game optimization for better performance. 
    [*]Numerous minor bug fixes.
   [/list]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/C5sS8h2VUAATz2e.jpg[/img]

[b]Game Sale![/b]
     Since [i]Potato Thriller[/i] is one of the greatest indie horror comedy games ever created (maybe), everyone should have a chance to experience it. New players interested in the experience can grab the game for 55% off! Limited time only. As of this update announcement (Feb 27, 2017)

[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/159153022666377763/2D1D7801739FE64055248DE6105216CF71DB68F5/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside|268:268&composite-to%3D%2A%2C%2A%7C268%3A268&background-color=black[/img]

[b]What's next from the developer?[/b]
     For fans of Potato Thriller, potential new fans or just gamers looking for something new in general, I am very proud to announce that my next game is in development. The game has been posted to Steam GreenLight a couple days ago and is available for voting 

here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=868133785 

For those who are interested of course. I am in no way begging for GreenLight votes. Please do vote honestly as I would like to examine the statistics and compare those who are genuinely interested and those who are not. 

[b]Thank you.[/b]
     As an indie game developer I absolutely love creating interactive experiences. I work hard to constantly improve and create better and better games each time. This may come as a surprise to some of you who have played Potato Thriller, but quality and originality are two of the most important things to me believe it or not. When it comes to games, it has always been about creating something fun. Something people can get a good laugh out of. Most of all, being different. Not creating games about collecting pages, surviving x amount of nights or killing waves of zombies. But, creating something different. Of course I understand that my games may not be appealing for everyone. However, the purpose is to offer something for those of you looking for something different. 

To the Potato Thriller community, people who played any of my games, left any form of feedback or criticism, visited my developer blog, talked to me on twitter, reached out to me, etc. I would just like to give the warmest thank you to all of you for all the support you have given me as a game developer. Thank you so much for your interest and inputs. You are all awesome. 

More news and updates to follow.

[i]-Samer Khatib (Snowconesolid Productions)[/i]
